name: context-pilot
description: Host-agnostic semantic compaction controller for Claude Code, with injected policy registries and interactive Mod UI.

auto_enabled.title: AUTO: automatic compaction
auto_enabled.description: ON (AUTO): probes and compactions run automatically after main-thread turns in interactive sessions. OFF (MANUAL): nothing forks or compacts automatically; /context-pilot evaluate (dry run) and /context-pilot compact remain available, and native compactions still receive the policy instructions.

show_status_band.title: Status band above the prompt
show_status_band.description: Show one line above the prompt with the active policy, context fill and progress bar, controller mode, next probe, and AUTO/MANUAL. Turn it off for a quieter prompt; /context-pilot still opens the full dashboard.

policy_registry_json.title: Policy registry (JSON)
policy_registry_json.description: The complete policy configuration as one JSON string (schema version 2; version 1 registries are rejected and must be re-saved as version 2). Top level: schemaVersion (must be 2), activePolicyId (must match one policy id), policies (one or more, unique ids). Each policy: id, label, thresholds {arm (earliest fill for semantic probes), mandatory (hard AUTO boundary), hostHeadroom (required distance between mandatory and the host's autocompact threshold)}, probe {minGap, maxGap (distance to the next probe), maxProbesPerCycle (integer 0..100; 0 = no probes), cacheFloor (0..1; probing pauses when the recent cache-read ratio falls below it)}, compaction {minProgress (growth required before another automatic compaction), directiveMaxChars (integer 1..8000), forkOnMandatory, injectNative (add policy instructions to native compactions), baseInstructions (non-empty)}. A threshold is {"unit":"tokens","value":N} with N > 0, or {"unit":"ratio","value":r} with 0 < r <= 1 of the context window. Rules checked against the live window: arm < mandatory <= window; minGap <= maxGap; minProgress < mandatory. Use /context-pilot config for the guided editor and its Help tab for the full schema.
